en.headline: St Stephen’s Society exhibition on Kowloon Walled City stories closes today at Central Market
en.dek: The multimedia show featuring artwork by residents of the charity and founder Jackie Pullinger’s decades of work runs until tonight on the first floor of Central Market.
body: A multimedia exhibition titled “285 and Counting” by St Stephen’s Society ends today at Central Market. The show, which opened on 18 October, presents artwork created by people who have stayed at the charity’s shelters together with photographs and accounts of founder Jacqueline “Jackie” Pullinger’s work in Hong Kong over more than fifty years.

The title refers to the number of different places the organisation has used to house people. Pullinger, a British missionary now in her eighties, has long worked with residents of the former Kowloon Walled City and with people recovering from drug addiction. The exhibition includes pieces by former school dropouts and others in recovery.

St Stephen’s Society operates a compound in the New Territories that includes art supplies and displays of residents’ work. Organisers said the Central Market display aims to share stories of recovery and community life. The exhibition is open until 10pm today on the first-floor event space.

Pullinger has said she regards the people she has worked with as the future of Hong Kong rather than as failures. The charity has provided shelter and support in multiple locations across the city over the decades.

zh.headline: 聖士提芬會「285個家」展覽今日於中環街市閉幕
zh.dek: 展覽展出受助居民作品及創辦人白嘉玲（Jackie Pullinger）逾五十年服務香港的故事，即日至今晚十時於中環街市一樓舉行。
body: 聖士提芬會多媒體藝術展「285個家・未完的香港故事」今日於中環街市閉幕。展覽自十月十八日起舉行，展出曾入住機構庇護所的居民創作藝術品，以及創辦人白嘉玲（Jackie Pullinger）在香港超過五十年工作的照片與記述。
標題中的「285」指機構多年來曾用作提供住所的地點數目。白嘉玲是一位現年八十多歲的英國傳教士，長期服務前九龍城寨居民及戒毒康復者。展品包括前轄學生及康復人士的作品。
聖士提芬會在新界的院舍設有藝術用品及居民作品展示。主辦方表示，中環街市展覽希望分享康復與社區生活的故事。展覽於一樓活動場地開放至今晚十時。
白嘉玲曾表示，她認為這些曾受助的人士是香港的未來，而非失敗者。機構數十年來在全港多個地點提供庇護與支援。
